component.name: Riff
component.summary: Practise with sheet music, video and audio in one place

description.p: Riff is a local-first practice workspace for musicians. It keeps a PDF score, a video lesson and an audio track side by side on one page, so you stop juggling three windows and start playing.
Riff has no accounts and no telemetry, and makes no network connections at all. Everything it stores lives in your own XDG directories as plain, editable files.
First release: onboarding, theming, navigation, the keyboard palette and fully working settings. Practice and History are visual placeholders.
